name: support-resolution
summary: Support agents resolve tickets: they read the ticket's customer's records in PostgreSQL, scoped to that customer and to public and internal columns, and refund Stripe test-mode payments, with an approver releasing refunds above 50.00 USD, refunds above 100.00 USD refused and a weekly refund budget.
covers: customer-scoped reads: support.tickets, shop.customers and shop.orders only for the named customers, narrowed to one ticket's customer with a delegated child grant
data classes: pii and secret columns are redacted, at most 50 rows a read, no aggregates
refunds held for an independent approver above 50.00 USD and refused above 100.00 USD
a refund never exceeds what is left to refund on the payment
a weekly refund budget of 500.00 USD per task in the grant baseline; the team-wide weekly cap is the template's guardrail envelope (pclaw template apply customer-support --team or --bu)
